items.title: For a perfect morphism the shriek of the structure sheaf is bounded coherent, of finite tor dimension, self dual, preserves bounded coherent objects and makes the comparison map an isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for a perfect morphism f : X -> Y of FTS_S the lemma asserts five things: f^!O_Y lies in D^b_Coh(O_X), has finite tor dimension over f^{-1}O_Y, makes O_X -> RSheafHom(f^!O_Y, f^!O_Y) an isomorphism, and that f^! maps D^b_Coh(O_Y) into D^b_Coh(O_X) and turns the comparison map mu_{f,K} of Lemma labelled lemma-map-pullback-to-shriek-well-defined into an isomorphism for all K in D_QCoh^+(O_Y) (statement lines 4797-4818). The proof notes that a flat finite presentation morphism is perfect of More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-flat-finite-presentation-perfect, then disposes of (a), (b) and (c) by reducing to affine X and Y, where Remark labelled remark-local-calculation-shriek translates them into assertions (1)(a), (1)(b) and (1)(c) of Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-relative-dualizing-algebraic, matched through Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemmas labelled perfect-lemma-tor-dimension-rel-affine, perfect-lemma-pseudo-coherent, perfect-lemma-identify-pseudo-coherent-noetherian and perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-internal-hom (proof lines 4820-4834). For (d) and (e) the proof first collects six preliminary remarks: that f^! sends D^+_Coh into D^+_Coh by Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-coherent; the open immersion case where f^! = f^* by Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-open-immersion; the perfect proper case settled by Lemma labelled lemma-compare-with-pullback-flat-proper-noetherian; locality in X for both (d) and (e); closure of (e) under composition using the diagram of Lemma labelled lemma-map-pullback-to-shriek-well-defined; and the deduction of (d) from (e) for a composite (proof lines 4836-4872). These reduce the problem to affine X, where an immersion X -> A^n_Y is factored as a perfect closed immersion followed by an open immersion into A^n_Y -> Y using Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-quasi-affine-finite-type-over-S and More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-perfect-permanence, so it suffices to treat a perfect closed immersion and the projection A^n_Y -> Y (proof lines 4874-4880). For a perfect closed immersion one has f^!K = RSheafHom(O_X, K) by Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-closed-immersion and f_*f^!K = RSheafHom_{O_Y}(f_*O_X, K) with f_*O_X perfect, which gives boundedness above and hence (d), with one step marked 'Some details omitted' (proof lines 4882-4896); for the projection, (d) follows by repeated application of Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-affine-line, and (e) holds because it holds for the flat proper P^n_Y -> Y and A^n_Y is open in P^n_Y (proof lines 4898-4902). Reducing the general case to a factorization into a perfect closed immersion and a projection, and collecting the six closure remarks, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
